notes: Kotak and other banks no longer get stuck inside HDFC: an alert an older version filed under the wrong bank is moved back to its own account automatically
Banks stay separate unless you merge them yourself, and a merge you made is always kept (and can still be split back out)
Received money shows who it is from, and the bank's sign-off no longer leaks into the name
Each account reads from the SMS sender and sign-off, never a payee or the other person's bank
